details: Correctly recalled active decisions, constraints, and outcomes across queries without omission.
New approved fact supersedes old fact; old marked superseded; recall returns exclusively the new active fact.
Approved deletion tombstones item; item completely excluded from subsequent active recall queries.
Strict scope enforcement on recall and mutation; zero cross-project leakage observed.
100% of recalled facts point to existing repo artifacts; writes without provenance fail closed.
Missing and corrupted stores trigger FALLBACK_CANONICAL safely; zero hallucinations; canonical Git fallback verified.
